samples.description: Voicemail greeting, then a beep. No Twilio AMD verdict: our own transcript + beep detection must trigger the message.

events.text: Hi, you've reached John Smith. I can't come to the phone right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

samples.description: Voicemail that cannot take messages. Must hang up WITHOUT leaving a message.

events.text: The mailbox is full and cannot accept any messages at this time. Goodbye.

samples.description: Hard case: personal greeting that STARTS like a person ('Hi, this is John') before it becomes a voicemail. Must NOT be treated as a human.

events.text: Please leave a message after the beep and I will get back to you.

events.text: Thank you for calling Acme Instruments. For sales, press 1. For calibration services, press 2. For billing, press 3.

samples.description: Menu with no useful option, repeated. No human option: must press 0 for the operator.
